races.display_title: KSR Lighting Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Despite failing to win a bumper between them, SMOKEHOUSE and The Mad Poet displayed plenty of ability and they could be the pair to focus on now hurdling. Marginal preference is for the Snowden inmate. Of the rest, point recruit Without Cause has to be of interest. SMOKEHOUSE (IRE) THE MAD POET (IRE) WITHOUT CAUSE (IRE)

races.display_title: BetMGM 'Future Stars' Silver Bowl 'Chasing Excellence' Novices' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Runner-up in a Grade 1 novice hurdle, KLIMT MADRIK has the physique to make at least as good a chaser and showed promise when runner-up at Worcester on his reappearance. He can build on that effort to go one better, though Royal Infantry made a winning chasing debut at Hexham and isn't taken lightly for the Skeltons. KLIMT MADRIK (FR) ROYAL INFANTRY (IRE) INTOSOMETHINGGOOD

races.display_title: BetMGM Haldon Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Grade 2) (Limited Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Successful in a Grade 1 novice here in April, MIRABAD made an encouraging return over hurdles when second in a listed race at Carlisle and he could still have more to offer as a chaser. He gets the vote ahead of JPR One , who showed that he retains all of his enthusiasm when defying top weight in a Cheltenham handicap on his reappearance, with Brookie also considered. MIRABAD (FR) JPR ONE (IRE) BROOKIE (IRE)

races.verdict: HERE COMES GEORGIE proved another fine advert for the sublime training skills of Dan Skelton at Cheltenham recently and can make light of a 7 lb rise for that strong-travelling success. Anthony Honeyball has an excellent recent record in this (when usually at Wincanton) and his Leave of Absence could prove the chief threat and the pick of his quartet. Montregard , Kap Vert and Konfusion all have plenty to recommend them too. HERE COMES GEORGIE LEAVE OF ABSENCE (FR) MONTREGARD (FR)
races.betting_forecast: Here Comes Georgie (5/2), Montregard (5/1), Leave Of Absence (11/2), Kap Vert (15/2), Konfusion (8/1), King Turgeon (12/1), Dartmoor Pirate (14/1), Master Chewy (16/1), Hold Your Fort (16/1), Marble Sands (16/1), Jasmin De Grugy (20/1), Gustavian (25/1)

races.verdict: There's a feeling the 3-y-os may come to the fore in this competitive opener. SOVEREIGN VIEW was tackling 1¼m for the first time when successful at Sandown in August and is narrowly preferred to Stoneacre Donny . races.display_title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: MARIANNE MOZART is putting it all together now, having shown improved form in a first-time hood before building on that promise to get off the mark at Kempton 9 days ago. She runs off an unchanged mark and can follow up. Lord Abama is only 2 lb higher than for a recent course success and that leaves him still very well treated on old form so he's respected and Pit Boss is capable if getting some luck and the race is run to suit his hold-up style. MARIANNE MOZART (IRE) LORD ABAMA (IRE) PIT BOSS

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cooley Fillies Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict: Lots with chances but AVIATRICE took this prize a year ago and is fancied to repeat the feat on the back of an excellent second here last time. Multiple course winner Carolina Jetstream heads the list of dangers, although a solid case can also be made for Suzie Songs , Leading Dancer and Prevalence . AVIATRICE (IRE) CAROLINA JETSTREAM SUZIE SONGS (IRE)
